verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a password manager or authenticator, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents a 2FAS command-line tool. The evidence shows only mobile apps, browser extensions, a browser keyboard shortcut and agent-readable docs (llms.txt, .md mirrors), and the llms.txt declares 'Public API: None'. None of these is a CLI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
